purpose: Teach: 初対面/待たさ/ヘッドホン/トレイ/興味津々/へっ/はぎ/通り過ぎる

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、初対面の転校生に話しかけてたな
lines.en: Riku, I saw you chatting up that transfer student you'd never even met.
lines.style: Pouncing tease on his name, sly drawn-out accusation, grin fully audible behind the words.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、放課後の塾で長く待たされたって愚痴ってたな、桜
lines.en: Yeah? And you were the one whining about getting kept waiting forever at cram school, Sakura.
lines.style: Instant flat comeback, cool unbothered pace, a smirk cracking through on her name.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、新しいヘッドホン買ったろ
lines.en: Riku, you totally bought new headphones, didn't you.
lines.style: Bright nosy attack on the first word, rising pitch fishing for a confession.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、給食でトレイの並べ方上手だな、桜
lines.en: And you're weirdly good at lining up the lunch trays, Sakura.
lines.style: Grudging offhand compliment, mumbled start, a small genuine lift landing on the praise.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、文化祭の出し物に興味津々だったな
lines.en: Riku, you were all wide-eyed over the culture festival stalls — admit it.
lines.style: Gleeful gotcha delivery, faster pace, laughter riding just under the words.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、「へっ、本気出せばまだ伸びる」って強がってたな、桜
lines.en: And you were doing that tough-guy act — 'heh, I'd still improve if I got serious' — weren't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Mocking impression on the quote, pitch dropped comically, dry deadpan return on her name.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、植物の授業で「はぎ」、つまり萩覚えたろ
lines.en: Riku, you actually memorized 'hagi' in plant class — bush clover, of all things.
lines.style: Fake-innocent question, syrupy slow on the plant name, needling him for being a secret nerd.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、自転車で他人の前を通り過ぎる時、声を掛けてたな、桜
lines.en: Well, you call out to total strangers every time you ride your bike past them, Sakura.
lines.style: Final counterpunch played slow and quietly triumphant, real warmth leaking in at the very end.
